name: snack_mogul_master
note: The master palette. Hand-authored BEFORE any generation, per plan §15 and work item 005 — never derived from model output. Passed as input_palette on every Retro Diffusion call, forever. Do not edit this file: a retroactive change invalidates every original generated under it. To move the look, add master_v2.json and repoint art/manifest.json.
structure: 40 colours as hue ramps rather than loose swatches: 7 warm neutrals, then soil / grass / wood / metal / starch / red / water ramps of 4-5 values each, then the 3 status-lamp accents not already covered by a ramp. Aesthetic target is §10.7 Stardew warm-and-limited at §10.6's locked 16px base tile.

swatches.name: ink
swatches.role: Darkest value in the game. Sprite outlines and the deepest occlusion shadow. Warm-shifted, never pure black.

swatches.name: umber
swatches.role: Deep shadow neutral. Under-eaves, machine recesses, the shaded half of a chunky bevel.

swatches.name: stone_dark
swatches.role: Stone and path shadow; UI panel border.

swatches.name: stone_mid
swatches.role: Stone and gravel midtone; the default neutral for anything not earth, wood or metal.

swatches.name: stone_light
swatches.role: Lit stone; dusty path highlight.

swatches.name: bone
swatches.role: Light warm neutral. Sacks, cloth, paper labels, UI panel fill.

swatches.name: paper
swatches.role: Lightest value in the game. Specular highlight and UI text-on-dark. Reserved — using it as a fill flattens everything near it.

swatches.name: soil_deep
swatches.role: Tilled-furrow shadow. The darkest earth value.

swatches.name: soil_wet
swatches.role: Watered tilled soil. READABILITY ROLE: the moisture state a player reads at a glance, so it must stay clearly darker than soil_dark.

swatches.name: soil_dark
swatches.role: Dry tilled soil body.

swatches.name: soil_mid
swatches.role: Untilled ground midtone; clod highlights on tilled soil.

swatches.name: soil_dry
swatches.role: Sun-baked dirt and dust. Lightest earth value.

swatches.name: leaf_deep
swatches.role: Foliage core shadow; the dark under a crop's leaves.

swatches.name: leaf_dark
swatches.role: Grass shadow and weed clumps on the untended lot.

swatches.name: leaf_mid
swatches.role: Base grass tile body. The most-used green in the game.

swatches.name: leaf_light
swatches.role: Lit grass blades; healthy crop foliage.

swatches.name: leaf_pale
swatches.role: New growth and top-lit leaf tips. Signals a young, thriving crop stage.

swatches.name: wood_dark
swatches.role: Plank shadow, fence posts, crate edges.

swatches.name: wood_mid
swatches.role: Timber body. Crates, the Chip Kitchen's frame, tool handles.

swatches.name: wood_light
swatches.role: Lit plank face and grain highlight.

swatches.name: wood_pale
swatches.role: Fresh-cut wood; the brightest timber accent.

swatches.name: metal_dark
swatches.role: Machine shadow and chassis outline. Cool on purpose — machines must not read as earth.

swatches.name: metal_mid
swatches.role: Machine body. The base tone of every fabricated object.

swatches.name: metal_light
swatches.role: Lit metal panel, hopper rims, belt frames.

swatches.name: metal_pale
swatches.role: Polished steel highlight and pipe specular.

swatches.name: tater_dark
swatches.role: Potato skin shadow and eye-dimples.

swatches.name: tater_mid
swatches.role: Potato skin body. The raw-potato item reads primarily as this.

swatches.name: tater_light
swatches.role: Lit potato skin; raw cut flesh.

swatches.name: chip_gold
swatches.role: Fried. The colour of a finished chip — deliberately the warmest bright in the palette so the product pops against soil and metal.

swatches.name: red_deep
swatches.role: Brand red shadow; the dark side of the chip bag.

swatches.name: red_mid
swatches.role: Chip-bag body and painted machine trim.

swatches.name: red_bright
swatches.role: STATUS ROLE: blocked. Also the chip bag's lit face. Chosen to survive as 3-4 pixels on soil_mid or metal_mid.

swatches.name: red_pale
swatches.role: Blocked-lamp bloom and warm rim-light on red surfaces.

swatches.name: water_deep
swatches.role: Water shadow; the inside of a sprinkler's tank.

swatches.name: water_mid
swatches.role: Water body and painted-blue utility hardware.

swatches.name: water_bright
swatches.role: STATUS ROLE: utility missing. Also the sprinkler's spray arc — the v0.1 grin depends on this reading instantly.

swatches.name: water_pale
swatches.role: Droplet highlight and spray tips. The brightest cool value.

swatches.name: lamp_running
swatches.role: STATUS ROLE: running. Deliberately more saturated and lighter than every grass green so a lamp never reads as foliage.

swatches.name: lamp_starved
swatches.role: STATUS ROLE: starved. Amber. Sits clear of chip_gold in saturation so a lamp does not read as product.

swatches.name: lamp_wrench
swatches.role: STATUS ROLE: wrench due. The only violet in the palette — nothing else in the world can be mistaken for it. §16 solves colourblind-safe status with lamp SHAPE as well, so this hue carries readability, not the whole burden.
